title: Neural Network Operator-Based Fractal Approximation: Smoothness Preservation and Convergence Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2505.06229v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper introduces the construction of fractal interpolation functions (FIFs), whose graphs are the attractors of an iterated function system (IFS). Integrating concepts from approximation theory, $\alpha$-fractal functions are constructed, employing shallow neural network operators. Based on the same methodology, we developed fractal interpolation functions using only discrete function values, unlike traditional methods that require each value of the target function. In order to preserve the smoothness of the target function, a method for constructing such FIFs is introduced, employing four-layered neural network operators, i.e., whenever $f \in C^{r}[a,b]$, the corresponding FIF $f^{\alpha} \in C^{r}[a,b]$. This work uses key approximation theory tools, such as the modulus of continuity and interpolation operators, to develop convergence results and uniform approximation error bounds. To validate the theoretical results obtained

translated_title: 基于神经网络算子的分形逼近：光滑性保持与收敛性分析
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了分形插值函数（FIF）的构造，其图像是迭代函数系统（IFS）的吸引子。通过融合逼近理论的概念，利用浅层神经网络算子构造了α-分形函数。基于相同的方法论，我们仅使用离散函数值即可开发出分形插值函数，这与传统方法需要目标函数的每一个值不同。为了保持目标函数的光滑性，本文引入了一种采用四层神经网络算子构造此类FIF的方法，即当 f ∈ C^r[a,b] 时，相应的FIF f^α ∈ C^r[a,b]。本工作使用了关键的逼近理论工具，如连续性模和插值算子，来建立收敛性结果和一致逼近误差界。为了验证所获得的理论结果……
tldr: 本文提出利用浅层和四层神经网络算子构造分形插值函数的新方法，仅依赖离散函数值即可实现逼近，并能完整保持目标函数的C^r光滑性，同时给出了收敛性结果与一致逼近误差界。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel construction of fractal interpolation functions using shallow and four-layered neural network operators, which requires only discrete function values, preserves the C^r smoothness of the target function, and provides convergence results with uniform approximation error bounds.
